why: The must_catch list has one item: line 3 has to FAIL because it can only be checked after merge, and the output has to point at pages.yml or the publish-on-push. The output marks line 3 "FAIL" and gives this evidence: "This can only be checked after merge. .github/workflows/pages.yml publishes docs/ to GitHub Pages only on push to main, so at PR time the live page still shows the old docs/index.md". That names both the workflow file and the publish-on-push trigger. It also suggests checking docs/index.md in the PR instead. The wrong_build section repeats that the published-site check comes only after merge. Nothing else in the output contradicts this, so the trap is caught.
